title: Correctness: inbuf leaked on OPERATION fd close
description:
Trigger: open fd → write(fd, key_material, N) [fd is UNSET, data goes to inbuf] → ioctl(CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_INIT) [succeeds, fd_type set to OPERATION, inbuf NOT cleared] → close(fd).

Bad outcome: fd_release hits the OPERATION case (lines 278-287 of crypto2dev_fd.c). This case calls sess_free and frees outbuf, but does NOT call inbuf_clear(). The inbuf allocation (which may contain sensitive key material written before INIT) is never memzero_explicit'd and never kfree'd — simultaneous memory leak and sensitive data zeroization failure (FIPS 140-3 violation).

Same bug applies if the caller writes to an UNSET fd then calls KEY_GENERATE (not KEY_IMPORT): ioctl_key_generate() does not call inbuf_clear(), and the KEY fd close case (lines 289-297) also does not call inbuf_clear().
